summary: Every press operation, setting, dimension, weld-nut current and torque, plating step and packing step is present and correctly bound, and the part list, revision and dates are correct. It fails on the header (UNIT-II instead of UNIT-3, Stage No. '1-15') and on many PPAP-derived extras: min shut heights, tool and liner sizes, WP-PRD-17, RMQP, FeZn8Cr III Y, hourly sampling, DFT meter, measuring tape and B.P. gauge. Rework rejects or re-forms dents instead of using a plastic mallet, replaces off-thickness sheet instead of re-cutting it, and returns rusted parts to the supplier.
